calls.reason: Li, Nye and Andreas show that state supervision improves coherence, but do not establish missing temporal world models as the central cause of GPT's errors.

Davis's February 1 report lacks readable prompts and answers. DRAW-1K shows substantial errors in nearby periods, but does not clearly establish recurring easy-word-problem failures in the cited update.

Search Engine Journal reports both post-update failures and successes. The later DRAW-1K study supports continuing difficulties, but neither establishes how much the relevant weakness persisted since 2019.

The BART/T5 study finds usable but error-prone state representations; Othello-GPT learns a causal board model. These narrow results do not settle the broader claim about robust event models from 2019 through early 2023.
